# Optica Egypt Local Section

> Official website of the Optica Egypt Local Section, connecting Egyptian students, researchers, universities, startups, and industry to the global photonics ecosystem.

Optica approved the charter of the Optica Egypt Local Section on 10 September 2026. The section serves as Egypt's national hub for optics and photonics research, professional networking, industry translation, and student development.

## Core Information
- Name: Optica Egypt Local Section
- Parent Organization: Optica (founded 1916, global society in optics and photonics)
- Approval Date: 10 September 2026
- Inauguration Ceremony: 1 November 2026
- Geographic Focus: Egypt (Cairo, Alexandria, Giza, Delta, Zewail City, and nationwide across universities)
- Official Website: https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/
- Contact: opticaegypt@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/optica-egypt

## Section Sitemap (4-Group Taxonomy)

### 1. Section
- [About](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/about/): Vision, mission, core values, charter milestones, and five-pillar operational strategy.
- [Leadership](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/leadership/): Founding Executive Council, Operational Committee, and Senior Faculty Advisory Board.
- [Recognitions](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/recognitions/): Optica Fellows in Egypt, Best Thesis and Graduation Project Fund, and student honors.
- [Partners](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/partners/): Institutional alliances, industry partners, university nodes, and sponsorship tiers.

### 2. Community
- [Community Overview](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/community/): Ecosystem connecting students, researchers, faculty, and industry.
- [Chapters](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/chapters/): Chartered university student chapters across Egypt.
- [Fellowships](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/fellowships/): Global Optica Foundation scholarships, travel grants, and career acceleration.
- [Outreach](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/outreach/): STEM roadshows, Youth Optics Discovery Days, and public science kits.
- [Volunteer](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/volunteer/): Functional volunteer tracks and in-page volunteer application portal.

### 3. Program
- [Events](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/events/): Upcoming seminars, workshops, and the Inauguration Ceremony (1 November 2026).
- [Conferences](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/conferences/): Flagship Egypt Photonics Conference (EPC 2027) and technical tracks.
- [Education](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/education/): Seasonal schools, curriculum modernization, and training modules.
- [Competitions](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/competitions/): Annual Photonics Design Hackathon and Open-Source Chipathon.
- [Open-Source](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/open-source/): Photonic Design Automation (PDA) with gdsfactory, Meep FDTD, and KLayout.
- [Resources](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/resources/): Curated simulation tools, textbooks, and open PDK references.

### 4. Insights and Primary Action
- [News](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/news/): Official section dispatches and charter announcements.
- [Blogs](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/blogs/): Technical articles, gdsfactory tutorials, and research spotlights.
- [Press](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/press/): Official boilerplate, press releases, downloadable SVG media kit, printable Fact Sheet, and press desk form.
- [Gallery](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/gallery/): Visual archive of workshops, cleanroom tours, and section milestones.
- [Join](https://iabdul-aal.me/optica_egypt/join/): Global Optica membership pathways and in-page Local Section Roster and Program Submission Portal.
